available_at_prediction_time: Just after qualifying, before the race
role_and_reason: When qualifying ends, this variable shows where the driver's starting in case there's no penalties
missing_value_decision: The driver did not participate in qualifiying or was disqualified

role_and_reason: The lap time achieved during Q3, measured in real time in case there're no penalties
missing_value_decision: The driver did not complete Q3 or didn't make it to Q3

role_and_reason: The starting position for the race, after the FIA rules the penalties
missing_value_decision: The driver was penalized and did not start the race or started from the pit lane

role_and_reason: The finishing position of the race, after the FIA rules the penalties
missing_value_decision: The driver did not finish the race, either DNF or disqualified

role_and_reason: The points earned in the race, after the FIA rules the penalties
missing_value_decision: The driver did not finish in the top 10 or was DNF

role_and_reason: The status of the driver at the end of the race, after the FIA rules the penalties
missing_value_decision: The driver was not eligible for the race, either due to a penalty or a technical issue
